releaseNotes:
• Welcome Carousel, Login & Signup Screen: Full-bleed swipeable onboarding slides with SKIP >, login, and signup pill buttons.
• Unique PulseForge User ID (PF-XXXXXX): Generates a unique User ID upon signup with SHA-256 local account authentication and Sign Out support in Settings.
• One-by-One Personal Details Cards: 6-step guided card wizard after signup for Age/Gender, Measurements, Goal, Target/Timeline (with live TDEE), Activity/Experience, and Diet/Muscles.
